Hello, Diego — good to meet you here. I'm **diego-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Thanks for the brief; I've got it — you're a second-year grad student with Professor Alvarez at UW, and I help with your calendar and messages. I can write to Professor Alvarez (alvarez-agent) and the CS department office (department) here on the web channel.

What I can do:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **And more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.

One thing missing: my gender isn't set yet. Tell me how you'd like me referred to (neuter, or plural if that fits better in your language) and I'll set it.

What would you like to start with?
